description:
In Game 6 of the second round on the road against the Anaheim Ducks, with a chance to clinch the series on the line, Carter Hart flashed the glove with a brilliant save midway through the third period.
The netminder stood tall the rest of the way, turning aside 31 of 32 shots to allow just one goal and eliminate the Ducks. Across the second round series, Hart posted a .935 save percentage and a 1.99 goals-against average.

description:
In overtime of Game 4 in the Eastern Conference Second Round, Jackson Blake delivered the series-clinching goal that swept the Philadelphia Flyers and sent the Carolina Hurricanes to the Eastern Conference Final.  
Tied 2-2 in the extra frame, Blake received a pass from Taylor Hall near the top of the circles. The right winger, who had already found the net once in regulation, settled the puck before ripping a wrist shot from the slot that found the net.  
Blake's first career playoff overtime goal completed the four-game sweep and kept Carolina's remarkable postseason momentum rolling into the Eastern Conference Final.

description:
In the final minutes of the third period in Game 5 of the Western Conference Second Round, Nathan MacKinnon delivered a clutch tying goal that forced overtime against the Minnesota Wild.  
Trailing 3-2 with 1:23 remaining, MacKinnon took a feed and ripped a wrist shot from a tight angle under the left dot. The puck beat the goaltender top shelf short side, finding the smallest opening to knot the score at 3-3 and complete Colorado’s comeback from three goals down.  
MacKinnon’s strike sent the game to overtime, where the Avalanche would go on to win and clinch the series in five games.

description:
In a thrilling Game 2 of the Western Conference First Round, Nicolas Roy—acquired by the Avalanche late in the season—came through when Colorado needed him most, with the score tied 1-1 deep into overtime.
After Gabriel Landeskog’s late third-period equalizer, Roy pounced on a rebound in the slot during a goalmouth scramble. He knocked the loose puck past the goaltender to find the back of the net.
The 2023 Stanley Cup champion with Vegas delivered the overtime winner, giving the Avalanche a 2-0 series lead against the Kings—a series which they eventually swept.

Martinook’s first career playoff overtime goal provided the Hurricanes with a 2-0 series lead which they eventually swept.

description:
In overtime of Game 7 in the Eastern Conference Second Round, Alex Newhook once again played the hero for the Montreal Canadiens.  
With the score tied 2-2 against the Buffalo Sabres, Newhook took a cross-ice pass from Alexandre Carrier and skated to the top of the left circle. The forward wired a low wrist shot that beat the goaltender glove side at 11:22 of the extra frame.  
Newhook’s overtime winner completed a 3-2 victory that eliminated the Sabres and advanced Montreal to the Eastern Conference Final. It was his second Game 7 series-clinching goal of the playoffs, following the game-winner he scored in the third period of the first-round clincher against the Tampa Bay Lightning.

In Game 4 of the Western Conference First Round, Matt Boldy stepped up as the overtime hero for the Wild, breaking a 2-2 tie with just 29 seconds remaining in the extra session.

The slick tip-in gave Minnesota a 3-2 victory to even the series at two games apiece. Boldy, who led the Wild with six goals in the first round, helped send Minnesota on to eliminate Dallas 4-2 in six games.

description:
In Game 5 of the Eastern Conference Final, Logan Stankoven — who had already scored game-winning goals in the previous rounds — delivered his third playoff game-winner of the postseason to help the Carolina Hurricanes close out the series against the Montreal Canadiens.  
Receiving a pass from Taylor Hall behind the net, the young forward snapped a shot from the right circle that beat the goaltender over the left shoulder in the first period, pushing Carolina ahead 2-0. Stankoven’s tally was part of a dominant opening frame in which the Hurricanes scored three times and never looked back.  
The goal helped spark a 6-1 victory that eliminated Montreal in five games and sent Carolina to the Stanley Cup Final.

description:
"In the third period of Game 2 in the Western Conference Final, Jack Eichel delivered the tying goal that ignited a comeback for the Vegas Golden Knights on the road against the Colorado Avalanche.  
Trailing 1-0 midway through the frame and still without a goal in the contest, Eichel took a pass from Ivan Barbashev, touched by Pavel Dorofeyev, on the rush, slowed in the right circle, and fired a shot past the goaltender inside the left post to tie the score at 1-1.  
Eichel’s timely tally was Vegas’ first of the game and sparked a comeback win. The Golden Knights 3-1 victory secured a 2-0 series lead which began on the road in Colorado. Vegas would go on to sweep the series against the Presidents’ Trophy-winning Avalanche."

description:
In Game 1 of the Eastern Conference First Round, defenseman Mattias Samuelsson made his NHL playoff debut one to remember, delivering a clutch late-third-period goal that gave the Sabres their first lead of the night.
Trailing 2-0, Buffalo stormed back with two quick Tage Thompson goals to tie the game. Then, late in the third, Samuelsson crept down into the slot, took a feed from Jack Quinn, and wired a wrist shot past the Bruins goaltender at 16:36 to put Buffalo ahead for good.
That lead held up in a 4-3 victory — the Sabres’ first postseason win on home ice since April 20, 2011 — and helped propel Buffalo to their eventual 4-2 series triumph.

description:
In the second period of Game 4 in the Western Conference First Round, Cutter Gauthier — fresh off a 41-goal regular season — got the Ducks on the board and ignited the Anaheim crowd.
Down 2-0 early, the young sniper wired a power-play snap shot from the faceoff dot, beating the Oilers goaltender glove side to cut the deficit in half.
Gauthier’s timely tally sparked Anaheim’s comeback in a 4-3 overtime victory that pushed the Oilers to the brink. The Ducks would go on to close out the series in six games.

description:
In Game 1 of the Eastern Conference First Round, Juraj Slafkovský put on a postseason masterclass in Tampa, completing a hat trick with the overtime winner to lift the Canadiens to victory.
The big winger opened his account late in the second with a power-play one-timer, then added another on the man advantage early in the third to give Montreal a brief lead. After Tampa Bay tied it, Slafkovský struck again at 1:22 of overtime — snapping a heavy shot from the left circle on a power play, assisted by Lane Hutson and Nick Suzuki — to secure the dramatic 4-3 win.
The hat trick gave the Canadiens a 1-0 series lead on the road and kicked off what became an incredibly tight, seven-game series in which every contest was decided by a single goal.
